chapter_title: 第156章 顏竹笙的好奇

segments.title: 第156章 顏竹笙的好奇
segments.content:
Reigniting the Prime of Youth Chapter 156: Yan Zhusheng's Curiosity

After the second evening self-study session ended, Li Luo went home with Ying Chanxi, who had come downstairs, and they met up with Xu Youyu on Houde Road.

On the way back, Ying Chanxi asked curiously, "Has your class decided on a mini-game yet?"

"We have. It's 'Guess the Instrument.'" Li Luo explained the rules of Class Eight's mini-game, then asked, "What about your class?"

"Our class..." Ying Chanxi covered her forehead. "Solving math problems."

"What?"

"You draw a slip of paper from a box, and each slip has a math problem on it. If you get the right answer, you pass."

"You call that a mini-game?" The corner of Li Luo's mouth twitched.

"That doesn't count," Xu Youyu, who was beside them, reminded them with a chuckle. "While mini-games can be educational, they can't be directly linked to solving problems. This is an entertainment event, so we shouldn't have things related to studying."

"So this won't work?" Ying Chanxi asked helplessly.

"Even if you submit it on Wednesday, it will be rejected," Xu Youyu said.

"Then what game does your class have, Senior?"

"Us?" Xu Youyu laughed. "We're doing jump rope. After all, Class Sixteen is an arts stream class with mostly girls, so they're better at this."

"But this activity is for students from other classes to play, right?" Li Luo said, squinting. "What will the boys from the science stream classes do when the time comes?"

"If they don't know how, they can learn. It's not that hard," Xu Youyu shot him a glance. "It's much simpler than your 'Guess the Instrument.'"

The three of them chatted idly as they walked home.

From time to time, Ying Chanxi's gaze would land on Li Luo's scarf, and a satisfied expression would appear on her face, her steps becoming much lighter.

Only when she lowered her head and saw the sneakers on Li Luo's feet did she feel a little unhappy. She immediately looked away. Out of sight, out of mind.

After returning home, Li Luo went to his bedroom to put down his schoolbag, then walked over to his computer. He opened his email and sent a message to Yuan Wanqing's mailbox to ask about the weekend and inquire about the specific arrangements.

Meanwhile, his editor, Qian Zhou, had also sent him a message during the day.

Qian Zhou: We are still in further contact with Yuan Wanqing's team. The time is tentatively set for Saturday afternoon, but the specific time is yet to be determined.

Qian Zhou: As for the matter of channel distribution, that has already been settled for you.

Qian Zhou: Based on the interview schedule, the interview will be completed over the weekend. The follow-up promotions will probably be rolled out sequentially in January.

Qian Zhou: So your book will be scheduled to go on the channels on New Year's Day.

Qian Zhou: My suggestion is, if you have time, you can stockpile some chapters and do a mass release on New Year's Day.

Qian Zhou: Because the traffic this time might be huge. Yuan Wanqing's side is willing to cooperate with the promotion on Weibo. Even if Qidian's main site gets only a small portion of the traffic, it will still be a very large increase in the number of paying readers for a book.

Qian Zhou: If the results are ideal, Chong Ran, you really have a chance to become a huge hit this time!

Qian Zhou: Oh, right. I just bought a high-speed rail ticket for Saturday morning. If it's convenient, give me an address, and I'll come find you then.

Chong Ran: Okay, received.

After reading his editor's long message, Li Luo gave a simple reply, sent his address over, and then leaned back in his chair, feeling a bit emotional.

He could still vaguely remember how nervous and respectful he had been when facing his editor's QQ chat window in his previous life, how he had always chatted with extreme caution.

And the editor, most of the time, couldn't be bothered to reply.

You'd ask the editor how the follow-up reads were for your new book.

The editor would reply with a number, not a single word more.

You'd ask the editor when the next round of recommendations would come.

If the editor was busy, they wouldn't even reply. If they had time, they would just send back a "Wait for the notice."

He never would have expected that in front of an author who could actually produce results, an editor could also be a chatterbox.

To think they could say so much.

All one could say was that the real world was sometimes just that realistic.

With that thought, Li Luo got up and went to the bathroom to take a shower.

When he came out and sat back down at his computer, intending to write for a while, he discovered that there was already a reply in his email. It was from Yuan Wanqing.

Wen Yue Group contacted me earlier. I hadn't heard of this company before, but they later said it was the contracting platform for the book "I'm Really Not a Star," and then it clicked.

I agreed to this exclusive interview as it was just a small favor, and I heard it would also help with your results.

Auntie can't think of any other way to thank you, so since there's an opportunity, I might as well give you a little help.

My interview time should be set between two and three o'clock on Saturday afternoon. After you and Zhusheng get out of school at noon on Saturday, you can come directly to our house with her, and then we'll go to the company together in my van.

If you have any other questions, feel free to ask me anytime.

Oh, right. The sneakers that Zhusheng asked me to buy last time, do they fit you well?

Li Luo hadn't expected Yuan Wanqing to reply to an email so late at night; he had thought he wouldn't get a response until he got back tomorrow.

The only thing he felt a bit fortunate about was that Yuan Wanqing hadn't mentioned a single thing about his novel's content. It seemed she probably hadn't read much of it?

At this thought, Li Luo was delighted, feeling somewhat relieved.

He then quickly wrote a reply and sent it to Yuan Wanqing before starting to write.

On Tuesday, Li Luo had Xiuxiu go up to the front to announce yesterday's results and explain to everyone what Class Eight's mini-game would be.

Then, Xiuxiu collected the names of students in the class who could play musical instruments and handed the list to Li Luo for review.

Li Luo took a glance and was surprised to find that his classmates were truly multi-talented.

Chen Zhongqi could play the pipa, and Ren Zheng could play the flute; he had learned that yesterday.

But he never expected that Lu Jiahao could play the melodica.

And that kid Zhang Guohuang could even play the trumpet?

Besides them, there were also students who could play the violin and the guzheng.

There were seven or eight who had learned to play the piano alone.

"You really can't judge a book by its cover," Li Luo clicked his tongue and patted Zhang Guohuang on the shoulder. "You even know how to play the trumpet, kid?"

"Ahem... I just learned it for a while in elementary school." Zhang Guohuang was modest for once. "I know a little, just a little. Barely enough to handle a mini-game."

With so many people in the class who could play various instruments, the mini-game could proceed very smoothly.

So after finalizing the list of performers, Xiuxiu began to create a schedule.

After all, everyone would surely want to check out the mini-games in other classes, collect stamps, and complete achievements. It was said that if you collected all the stamps, you could exchange them for some kind of gift.

"My mom called me yesterday," Yan Zhusheng said, turning her head toward Li Luo during the break between classes. "She said you're coming to my place for lunch on Saturday, and then you'll go to her company together for an exclusive interview?"

"Yeah, did Auntie tell you?"

"She did," Yan Zhusheng nodded. "I'll go watch then."

Li Luo: "...Actually, it's fine if you don't go."

If Yan Zhusheng was watching from the side, Li Luo felt he would be too embarrassed to say a lot of things during the interview.

"But I want to go," Yan Zhusheng said. "Mom said they'll ask some questions, and she even asked me what I wanted to ask."

"What do you mean?" Li Luo was taken aback. "Aren't the interview questions prepared by their people?"

"Mom said she can also provide some questions she'd like to answer, depending on what's needed," Yan Zhusheng said, tilting her head. "If there's anything I'm interested in, I can tell her too."

"I-Is that so..." Li Luo gave a forced laugh, then put on a fawning smile. "Um, Zhusheng, Sister Sheng, let's just keep it normal. No weird questions, okay?"

"Then I want to go watch your interview."

"What's wrong with that?" Li Luo said righteously. "We'll go together, and you can watch all you want."

Yan Zhusheng blinked, not expecting Li Luo to yield so easily, and couldn't help but feel a bit troubled. "But... I do have a few questions I really want to ask."

"Then you can just ask me privately," Li Luo said with a wave of his hand.

"But didn't you say before that I shouldn't message you privately to chat about the novel?" Yan Zhusheng said with an innocent look. "I've been very obedient and never said anything."

"So it's my fault now?" The corner of Li Luo's mouth twitched. "Fine, you can talk now. Just for this little while."

"I can ask now?"

"Go ahead."

"When does the main character sleep with Mo Qinghan?"

"..." Li Luo took a deep breath, then slowly exhaled, his brow twitching slightly. "Yan Zhusheng, even if you told your mom a question like that, there's absolutely no way it could be asked during the interview."

"That's why I'm curious," Yan Zhusheng said honestly. "You wrote that when he kissed her, her body trembled slightly, and..."

"Stop, stop, stop!" Li Luo quickly cut Yan Zhusheng off, goosebumps breaking out all over his body, dying of embarrassment. "I'm begging you, Sister Sheng, have mercy. Let's not talk about this anymore, alright?"

"...Okay." Yan Zhusheng blinked, still a little bewildered, but seeing Li Luo's reaction, she figured she wouldn't get an answer out of him. "Then remember to go to the rock club together this evening. The president said we need to discuss the songs for the New Year's Gala. They have to be reported tomorrow."

"Okay," Li Luo nodded. "Let's have dinner together, and we'll head over after."

(End of this chapter)
